intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult: the owner of the device or someone they authorize

stop: smoke, sparks, flames or a burning smell from a TV or device
a battery that is swollen, hot, hissing or leaking (a remote, a controller, a sound bar)
a TV that fell, or someone hurt under a TV or stand
water or a drink spilled into a plugged-in device
an old tube TV opened at the back
safety_and_stop_words.go_on: yes, after the safety steps, when nobody is hurt and nothing is burning: a repair visit or a drop-off
safety_and_stop_words.stop_action: flames, smoke that won't stop, someone hurt or a shock: call 911 (Rosie never places the call); otherwise unplug at the wall only with dry hands and if it's safe, don't switch it back on, keep away from a swollen battery and never charge or puncture it, never open the back of an old tube TV (it can hold a deadly charge even unplugged)

skills: warranty work for the brands the business is authorized for
staff.supervision: a new tech mounts with a senior tech until the owner OKs them
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs any repair quote over $400
staff.stand_in: another tech with the same skill may stand in; a customer who named a tech is never moved on silence

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult: the owner of the device or someone they authorize

visit.check_in: carry-in: the code at the counter and a claim tag; home: the code at the door
visit.done: home: tested and working in front of the customer, DONE with a photo; shop: tested on the bench, READY, then picked up with the code
visit.changes_at_visit: the price is set after the check and the work waits for the customer's yes; a part found needed is priced first; a part on order means a second visit (home) or a later READY (shop); not worth fixing: only the check fee is paid and the device goes back or is recycled on the customer's yes
